description: Mistral API key hardcoded three times: as a MISTRAL_API_KEY module constant in a Python assistant (detected), as a quoted "MISTRAL_API_KEY" entry in the env block of the committed Claude Code project settings (.claude/settings.json; detected only since the rule accepts a quoted key), and inline in `new Mistral({ apiKey: "…" })` in a Next.js lib file. The last is the SDK constructor shape, with no MISTRAL_API_KEY name for the context-anchored rule to key on — a known gap.
